Dissipation
Case Design
We borrow the case design idea from Moxa and Simens.
The upper panel, aluminum
The other sides, iron
Question: Why not do aluminum for all the panels?
Answer: aluminum is softer and easier to bend than iron.
There will be some connectors(like DIP, power terminal block, din rail holes) on the panels, iron in this case is more stable in molding and production.
In industrial environments, long-term running will generate much heat, aluminum is prone to deformation.
Based on 2 above reasons, we have this case design considering heat dissipation and beautiful outlook.
Heat Sink
For some regular devices with fewer ports, lower PoE output, generally no special treatment is required.
Saga Telecom also offers some PoE++ standard industrial switches.
When the switch is working at full-load, plenty of heat will be mainly generated from SFP modules, Chip and PCB boards.
Those switches with more ports, higher speed usually carry more networking data and play a core role in the transmission system.
Better dissipation secures
Longer service life, less maintenance
Stable operation(poor dissipation will cause packet loss from time to time though the transmission keeps running)
In light of this, Saga Telecom design a unique case and put in more heat sinks to dissipate from the
upper panel of aluminum.
放那个外壳图	放散热片图
Meanwhile, Saga Telecom test the switches at full-load mode for 72 hours to check if there is any packet loss.
放那个技术室测试设备图	放是否丢包的测试界面
By doing this, continuous operation in harsh industrial environments is ensured.
Iron Baffle
This is usually seen in Saga Telecom 1U rack hot-swappable PoE switches.
2 types of power modules are offered, 440W or 850W.
下边放图
When this switch is running at full load, much heat will be trapped in the rack.
The heat is mainly from the power module(s), to avoid the movement of heat inside the chassis and ensure better dissipation via the fans.
An iron baffle(not aluminum) is mounted to isolate the heat from the power module and from the SFP modules, chip and PCB boards.
For the heat from the power module, it will be discharged via the fans.
For the heat from the SFP modules, chip and PCB boards, it will be discharged via the heat sinks and the upper panel of aluminum.
This enhances dissipation efficiency and avoid possible packet loss from over-heating.
EMC
In some extremely harsh industrial productions like iron and oil refining or nuclear power projects,  high intensity electromagnetic interference will causing dysfunction or even failure to industrial Ethernet switches.
To encounter this, Saga Telecom adopt high-standard materials and special design.
6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection

Case Design
We borrow the case design idea from Moxa and Simens.
The upper panel, aluminum
The other sides, iron
Question: Why not do aluminum for all the panels?
Answer: aluminum is softer and easier to bend than iron.
There will be some connectors(like DIP, power terminal block, din rail holes) on the panels, iron in this case is more stable in molding and production.
In industrial environments, long-term running will generate much heat, aluminum is prone to deformation.
Based on 2 above reasons, we have this case design considering heat dissipation and beautiful outlook.
Heat Sink
For some regular devices with fewer ports, lower PoE output, generally no special treatment is required.
Saga Telecom also offers some PoE++ standard industrial switches.
When the switch is working at full-load, plenty of heat will be mainly generated from SFP modules, Chip and PCB boards.
Those switches with more ports, higher speed usually carry more networking data and play a core role in the transmission system.
Better dissipation secures
Longer service life, less maintenance
Stable operation(poor dissipation will cause packet loss from time to time though the transmission keeps running)
In light of this, Saga Telecom design a unique case and put in more heat sinks to dissipate from the
upper panel of aluminum.
Meanwhile, Saga Telecom test the switches at full-load mode for 72 hours to check if there is any packet loss.

Iron Baffle
This is usually seen in Saga Telecom 1U rack hot-swappable PoE switches.
2 types of power modules are offered, 440W or 850W.
下边放图
When this switch is running at full load, much heat will be trapped in the rack.
The heat is mainly from the power module(s), to avoid the movement of heat inside the chassis and ensure better dissipation via the fans.
An iron baffle(not aluminum) is mounted to isolate the heat from the power module and from the SFP modules, chip and PCB boards.
For the heat from the power module, it will be discharged via the fans.
For the heat from the SFP modules, chip and PCB boards, it will be discharged via the heat sinks and the upper panel of aluminum.
This enhances dissipation efficiency and avoid possible packet loss from over-heating.
EMC

In some extremely harsh industrial productions like iron and oil refining or nuclear power projects,  high intensity electromagnetic interference will causing dysfunction or even failure to industrial Ethernet switches.
To encounter this, Saga Telecom adopt high-standard materials and special design.

先讲优势：
1. 在中国做交换机品牌里算得上是二线品牌，品牌积累还不错！
2. 公司技术实力虽然比不上华为，华三，锐捷等一线品牌，但是在交换机领域的技术沉淀也是很有实力，研发人员应该有上百人左右！
3. 海外市场布局较早，在海外有一定的知名度，也有一批忠实客户（无论是OEM还是品牌客户）
中性信息：产品方案有Broadcom, Centec and Realtek
相对劣势：（我们的机会点）
1. 由于公司上了一定的规模，会有一些大公司的通病，响应客户需求的时间长，客户多有抱怨！
2. 尤其是对于中小客户，价格高，MoQ要求高
3. 对于大客户的政策支持方面有时候让大客户没有安全感，在某些市场存在跟代理商或者大客户直接抢订单的行为
面对博达的客户，你们需要先了解他们属于博达哪个级别的客户，跟博达合作哪种类型的产品为主，然后再去分析机会点在哪里
至于Broadcom, Marvell, Vitesse, Realtek 这些芯片方案，都有自己的客户群体，不能说某一个芯片一定是最好的，只要是适合客户的就是最好的
有些客户就需要价格便宜能用就可以，我们非要跟客户讲Broadcom 和Marvell 很高端比Realtek 好很多，很显然这种讲法对于这种类型的客户就不合适
还是那句话，专业的客户对于芯片的了解和选型他们比我们更专业！对于半桶水的客户，假如单纯来比较这几个交换机的芯片，可以这样跟他们讲：
1. Broadcom: 布局主要在于数据中心等高端交换机上，SMB 以及 campus switch 有一些但是不是他们主要的产品线
2. Marvell: 产品线相对丰富，既有高端的data center switch 方案，也有SMB ,campus switch 方案
3. Vitesse: 产品线很窄，基本就是常用的那几颗芯片，主要针对的是接入型以及SMB市场，后续产品也不会有扩展
4. Realtek: 主要是针对安防以及SOHO 市场，没有针对data center，campus等应用场景的高端交换机方案
Stacking: 虚拟化，运营商用的多，是个协议，一般情况下客户用不起来，这个会牵涉到比较大的运营网络
TSN: 一共是16个协议，目前有一定商用场景，但并未广泛适用且国内成熟方案非常少，只能支持少数功能，基本是噱头宣传，多用于车载，物联网，敏感行业如电力/矿井等，是未来工业网络的基石
Cloud Management: 技术上并不是特别难，台湾做的比较多（工业级）以及国内一些公司在做商业级的云管理和Web管理，实质上只是增加了一些技术细节，物料差别不大
